# Vendored JavaScript of the 3D page

Downloaded on 2026-11-08 from the npm registry, as the release tarball of each
package. Only the files the page loads are kept, each package with its licence.

| Package | Version | Licence | Files |
|---|---|---|---|
| `three` | 0.180.0 | MIT | `build/three.module.min.js`, `build/three.core.min.js`, `examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js`, `examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js` |
| `@pixiv/three-vrm` | 3.5.5 | MIT | `lib/three-vrm.module.min.js` |

`three-vrm` 3.5.5 was built against `three` 0.180.0, so that version is kept.
Replace a package by downloading its release again with its licence; never edit
these files.
